A new adventure blasts off across the stars.
In Super Mario Galaxy (2026), Mario’s cosmic journey expands with the long-awaited reveal of Yoshi. As galaxies collide and colorful worlds await, teamwork, friendship, and classic Nintendo magic take center stage.

Featuring Chris Pratt as Mario, this official 4K reveal trailer teases gravity-defying action, playful humor, and the vibrant charm fans love — all set on a galactic scale.
